Reserve Bank of New Zealand — Official Cash Rate announcement

19 November 2026

At its meeting today, the Monetary Policy Committee agreed to reduce the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 50 basis points to 4.25 per cent.

Annual consumer price inflation is returning to the 1 to 3 per cent target band. Economic growth remains subdued.

The Committee's future OCR decisions will be data-dependent. The Committee will continue to assess inflation and employment prospects.
